# First Source Wireless

> First Source Wireless is an authorized distributor of tactical communication headsets, ballistic helmets, two-way radios, and professional audio equipment from brands like 3M PELTOR, Ops Core, Silynx, Harris, and Cradlepoint.

The site specializes in communication solutions for law enforcement, military, aviation, manufacturing, and enterprise markets. They offer protective gear, antenna systems, wireless connectivity products, and accessories from leading manufacturers including 3M, Motorola, Kenwood, and Cradlepoint.

## Key Topics

- 3M PELTOR
- Tactical Headsets
- Ballistic Helmets
- Two-Way Radios
- Law Enforcement Equipment
- Hearing Protection
- Wireless Communications
- Harris M/A-Com
- Motorola APX
- Cradlepoint 5G
- Larsen Antennas
- Aviation Headsets
- Manufacturing Headsets
- Push-to-Talk Adapters
- Protective Cases

## Tactical & Law Enforcement

- [Law Enforcement Communication Systems & Tactical Headsets](https://firstsourcewireless.com/collections/law-enforcement-communication-systems): Law enforcement tactical headsets from 3M Peltor and Silynx with P25 compatibility
- [Galvion Ballistic Helmets](https://firstsourcewireless.com/collections/galvion): Galvion ballistic helmets including Caiman and Viper models for military/law enforcement
- [Push to Talk Headset Adapters](https://firstsourcewireless.com/collections/push-to-talk-headset-adapters): 3M PELTOR and Motorola APX PTT headset adapters with military connector standards
- [Harris OEM Two-Way Radio Accessories](https://firstsourcewireless.com/collections/harris-oem-radio-accessories): Harris OEM radio accessories for P5400, P5300 two-way radios and related equipment
- [Police Motorcycle Radio Equipment](https://firstsourcewireless.com/collections/police-motorcycle-gear): Setcom motorcycle helmet communication kits for law enforcement with Motorola/Kenwood radios

## Hearing Protection & Audio

- [Shooting Ear Protection - 3M Peltor Earmuffs for Hunting](https://firstsourcewireless.com/collections/peltor-3m-hunting-shooting): 3M PELTOR shooting earmuffs for hunting with NRR 22-30dB passive/electronic protection
- [3M E-A-R Earplugs](https://firstsourcewireless.com/collections/e-a-r): 3M E-A-R molded and corded earplugs for hearing protection in loud environments
- [HP Poly Headsets - Office, Call Center & Microsoft Teams Certified](https://firstsourcewireless.com/collections/plantronics-dispatch-headsets): HP Poly professional headsets for office and call centers with Teams certification

## Wireless Communications & Enterprise

- [Cradlepoint Routers & 5G Modems - NetCloud Wireless WAN](https://firstsourcewireless.com/collections/cradlepoint): Cradlepoint 5G routers and NetCloud wireless WAN for enterprise mobile connectivity
- [Pulse Larsen Antennas - 4G LTE, GPS, WiFi](https://firstsourcewireless.com/collections/larsen-antennaspulse-electronics): Pulse Larsen authorized antenna distributor for 4G LTE, GPS, WiFi, HAM radio
- [PCTEL Antennas - LMR, GPS, Cellular Antenna Solutions](https://firstsourcewireless.com/collections/pctel-antennas): PCTEL authorized dealer for LMR, GPS, cellular, and LTE antenna solutions

- [Warehouse Headsets and Communication Solutions](https://firstsourcewireless.com/collections/warehouse-communication-headsets): 3M Peltor and Plantronics warehouse headsets for distribution center communication
- [Airport Ramp Agent Headsets - Aviation Ground Crew Communication](https://firstsourcewireless.com/collections/airline-airport-ramp-agent-headsets-aviation-ground-crew-communication): 3M PELTOR aviation headsets for airport ramp agents with 30dB NRR noise protection
